label: Binary Data
depicts: Abstract bit-like shapes arranged as machine-level binary marks.
use_when: Strongest in developer tools, data inspection, code, or systems contexts.
avoid_when: Outside technical contexts, some users may only read it as numbers or code decoration.
semantic_tags: Binary data or low-level digital values
synonyms: Binary data or low-level digital values

label: Modules
depicts: A large rounded block with a smaller detached block above it.
use_when: Strongest in modular systems, integrations, component libraries, or architecture views.
avoid_when: It can also read as toy blocks or generic shapes if the surrounding product context is weak.
semantic_tags: Modules, building blocks, or composable parts
synonyms: Modules, building blocks, or composable parts

label: Assistant Message
depicts: A robot-like chat bubble with a message panel.
use_when: Strongest in chat, assistant, support, and agent workflows.
avoid_when: It could be read more generally as bot chat, not necessarily one specific assistant role.

label: AI Reasoning
depicts: A brain shape with circuit-style nodes and branches.
use_when: Strongest in AI, inference, reasoning, automation, or intelligence features.
avoid_when: It can be read either as AI reasoning or more broadly as intelligent systems.
semantic_tags: AI reasoning, machine intelligence, or neural-style computation
synonyms: AI reasoning, machine intelligence, or neural-style computation

label: Compute Architecture
depicts: A rounded square board with circuit nodes and traces.
use_when: Strongest in hardware, systems, architecture, developer tooling, or infrastructure views.
avoid_when: Some users may read it as generic tech rather than one exact hardware object.
semantic_tags: Compute architecture, hardware logic, or system circuitry
synonyms: Compute architecture, hardware logic, or system circuitry
